chips.text: Saskatoon Land needs name 24 months in advance for branding and marketing.
Councillor asked if "Hawthorn" has Cree meaning and about Indigenous consultation.
Councillor expressed discomfort with name due to lack of community argument and process.
Administration developing interim approach for future naming requests and new policy by spring.

description: City staff member Nick Kinsel leaves Naming Committee.
Administration is planning for his replacement and committee work.

chips.text: Councillor Davis questioned if committee members would be involved in future planning.
Staff clarified that administration decisions are separate from committee policy oversight.
Will Naming Committee members be included in the report's initial engagement phase?
